verdict.rationale: OpenClaw ships Automations as a built-in scheduler that persists jobs, wakes the agent on schedule, and delivers output to chat, a webhook, or nowhere. Runs can also be triggered by webhooks, Gmail PubSub, and IMAP. Standing orders grant permanent operating authority for autonomous programs, sub-agents run in the background, and a community user independently reports scheduling tasks across 9 agents. Missing for 10: detailed documentation or hands-on evidence on monitoring, failure handling, and reliability of unattended background runs.
